name: Halloween Spooktacular: Midnight Dossiers
description: Curated Halloween special cards blending Paranoid Times lore with seasonal conspiracies.
author: Paranoid Times Narrative Desk

cards.name: Bat Boy's Midnight Canvass
cards.text: +2 Pressure. If you're behind on state control, all your states gain +1 Defense.
cards.flavor: Bat Boy autographs voter rolls with ultraviolet ink from the Paranoid Times printroom.

cards.name: Elvis Broadcasts from the Corn Maze
cards.text: +3% Truth. If Truth ≥ 55%, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Elvis tunes the TruthMeter™ to 'harvest moon' and croons classified setlists.

cards.name: FOIA Séance Hotline
cards.text: +2% Truth. If Truth ≤ 40%, add +1 Pressure in any state.
cards.flavor: Maria Chen patches in spectral operators through the Hamtrak switchboard.

cards.name: Pumpkin Spice EMF Sweep
cards.text: +1 Pressure plus +1 per state you control (max +2).
cards.flavor: Garage CSI rigs latte frothers as EMF sniffers—mint condition.

cards.name: Haunted Ham Radio League
cards.text: +2% Truth. If you control 5+ states, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Pastor Rex runs carrier pigeons and Channel 13.13 simultaneously.

cards.name: Crypt Keeper Canvassing Kit
cards.text: Opponent −2 IP. If Truth ≥ 60%, opponent loses 1 additional IP.
cards.flavor: Starter kit ships with glow-in-the-dark affidavits and Bat Boy door hangers.

cards.name: Pumpkin Patch Polygraph Party
cards.text: +1% Truth. If Truth ≤ 35%, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: TruthMeter™ wristbands flash whenever the scarecrow lies.

cards.name: Ghost Tour Door Knockers
cards.text: +2 Pressure in a state and +1 Pressure to every contested state.
cards.flavor: Neighborhood Watch (For UFOs) repurposes lanterns as disclosure beacons.

cards.name: Pastor Rex's Exorcism Tent
cards.text: +3% Truth. If you're behind on states, add +2 Pressure anywhere.
cards.flavor: Blessed mics banish lies faster than the Department of Seasonal Repression can draft memos.

cards.name: TruthMeter™ Lantern Parade
cards.text: +3 Pressure and +1% Truth per state you control (max +4%).
cards.flavor: Maria Chen syncs every lantern to the Paranoid Times seismic rumormill.

cards.name: Office of Seasonal Repression
cards.text: −3% Truth. If Truth ≥ 60%, opponent discards 1 card.
cards.flavor: Deputy Director Walsh files candy confiscations under Annex 31-Boo.

cards.name: Pumpkin Spice Cover-Up Division
cards.text: −2% Truth. If you control 5+ states, reduce Truth by 1% more.
cards.flavor: Classification Czar Pierce stamps the latte foam with [REDACTED].

cards.name: Voluntary Curfew for the Undead
cards.text: +2 Pressure and all your states gain +1 Defense.
cards.flavor: Compliance drones croon lullabies from the Department of Nightlife Normalization.

cards.name: Haunted Hearing Adjournment
cards.text: −1% Truth. If Truth ≤ 30%, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Minutes prepared in triplicate, candles billed to the Containment Annex.

cards.name: Pumpkin Spice Riot Insurance
cards.text: Opponent −1 IP. If Truth ≥ 55%, opponent loses 1 additional IP.
cards.flavor: Actuaries fold riot-ready pumpkins into the Continuity of Government coverage binder.

cards.name: Containment Order: Bat Boy
cards.text: +3 Pressure. If Truth ≥ 65%, add +1 more Pressure.
cards.flavor: Agent Smitherson requisitions silver-plated NDAs before dawn.

cards.name: Emergency Candy Recall
cards.text: −2% Truth. If you're behind on states, opponent loses 1 IP.
cards.flavor: General Thompson reclassifies nougat as contraband biomatter.

cards.name: Skeletonized Logistics Corps
cards.text: Opponent −2 IP. If you control 6+ states, add +1 Pressure anywhere.
cards.flavor: Autonomous forklifts run on black-budget ectoplasm.

cards.name: Black Budget Ghost Trap
cards.text: −4% Truth. If you control 6+ states, opponent discards 1 card.
cards.flavor: Prototype cobbled from Project Specter receipts and Denver Airport wiring.

cards.name: Memo: Replace Fog with Classified Mist
cards.text: −1% Truth. If you control 4+ states, add +1 Pressure anywhere.
cards.flavor: Directive scribbled on Department of Atmospheric Cover letterhead.
